dev: Design Cart — Paweł Nosko . Designed for OpenCart 3.0.x and 3.5.x. Works with any theme — CSS selectors are fully configurable. Full documentation and screenshots: DC Omnibus for OpenCart — project page Why choose DC Omnibus? Omnibus ready — shows “Lowest price in 30 days” next to promotional prices Sync active promotions — essential one-click tool to backfill cache for promotions that existed before module installation Automatic logging — every product save with a special price updates the history No database bloat — lightweight JSON files in storage/dc_omnibus_cache/ Multi-language labels — customize the panel text per language Full styling control — panel background, label and price typography (color, size, bold, uppercase) Flexible placement — insert panel before or after any CSS selector on the product page Smart display modes — show always or only when product is on promotion Admin tools — browse cache files and view full price history per product Currency & customer groups — history tracked per currency and customer group Option prices ignored — uses base product special price only (as required for Omnibus scope) Screenshots Storefront — product page with Omnibus panel Admin — General tab Admin — Appearance tab Admin — Frontend tab Admin — Languages tab Admin — Files tab (sync active promotions) Admin — History tab Sync active promotions — important for existing stores If your store already has products on sale when you install DC Omnibus, those prices are not in the module history yet. The Sync active promotions button (admin → DC Omnibus → Files tab) scans your database and creates cache files for every currently active special price — in one click. Recommended workflow after installation: Install and enable the module Open DC Omnibus → Files tab Click “Sync active promotions” Verify files appear in the cache list Check a product page on the storefront Admin panel features General — Module status, administrative name Appearance — Panel background, label typography, price typography, live preview Frontend — Special price CSS selector, display mode, insertion selector, before/after position Languages — Custom label per language (e.g. “Lowest price in 30 days”) Files — Cache file list, Sync active promotions button History — Full price log for selected product (date, price, currency, customer group) Compatibility OpenCart 3.5.x — fully supported (primary target) OpenCart 3.0.x — supported Not compatible with OpenCart 2.x or 4.x Any OpenCart 3 theme (configure CSS selectors) Multi-store, multi-language, multi-currency Technical notes Price logging via OpenCart events ( addProduct/after , editProduct/after ) Front integration via OCMOD (product controller + product template) JavaScript: catalog/view/javascript/dc_omnibus/dc_omnibus.js Cache path: storage/dc_omnibus_cache/{product_id}.txt 30-day rolling window; entries older than 30 days excluded from lowest price calculation Front end is read-only — never modifies cache files Support & links Design Cart · www.designcart.pl · info@designcart.pl Author: Paweł Nosko Project page: Omnibus for OpenCart — free extension Module version: 1.0.3 Login and write down your comment.
